title: Sleep in the Tide

note.ja: 第2部 子守歌(歌声入り。ループしない)
note.en: Part 2. A lullaby (with vocals; does not loop)

lyrics:
Deep in the dark
Where spirits lie
The water sings
A soft goodbye
No more to weep
No more to dread
Rest now your heart
My gentle dead
Sleep in the tide
The city is still
Bow to the waves
And accept their will
Sleep in the tide
The light fades away
Finding your peace
At the end of the day
Sink to the depths
The struggle is o'er
Safe in the dark
And forever more

title: Throne Beneath the Tide

note.ja: 第2部 湖がまた満ちていくエンディング(歌声入り)
note.en: Part 2. An ending as the lake fills again (with vocals)

lyrics:
The water rises tall and cold
To take back what was ours of old
A silent queen on silver throne
I face the endless deep alone
Let floodgates close and shadows fall
Upon this great and empty hall
My people sleep in liquid stone
And here I sit, forever home
The crown is heavy, wet with tears
To wash away a thousand years
The silence is a blessed friend
As we arrive at this, the end
Oh, let the waters draw us down!
To wear this cold and aquatic crown!
My capital sinks to the deep, blue sea!
An eternal grave for royalty!
I'll stay and watch until the light!
Is swallowed by the endless night!
Farewell, my world, my story told!
As everything turns still and cold!
(Water draws us down)
To where no one can find me
(Silence is my crown)
Leaving everything behind me
(Wait for a new dawn)
In a story yet to start
Now I am truly gone
A ghost within the heart

note.ja: 第3部 見送りの儀式。弔いの鐘を三つ打ってから、子守歌が重なる(頭の鐘は合成して重ねた。ループしない)
note.en: Part 3. The rite of sending off. Three funeral tolls, then the lullaby (the bells were synthesized and laid over the head; does not loop)

title: Crown Upon the Floor

note.ja: 第3部 三部作のエンディング。長い夜の明け方(歌声入り。ループしない)
note.en: Part 3. The ending of the trilogy. Dawn after a long night (with vocals; does not loop)

lyrics:
Ooh, the long night ends...
Rest now, the dawn is here...
The deep hum fades to silver grey
The heavy stone has ceased to play
The hollow heart is cold and still
The morning climbs the lonely hill
And the dawn breaks, soft and wide
Turning the shadows to the tide
No more the ghost, no more the toll
The quiet light begins to console
The crown is laid upon the floor
The iron key locks every door
The path is worn, the boots are home
Beneath the sky, no more to roam
And the dawn breaks, soft and wide
Turning the shadows to the tide
No more the ghost, no more the toll
The quiet light begins to console
The night was long, the debt is paid!
In silence now, the ghosts are laid!
The earth is green, the air is thin!
The final day can now begin!
Rest in the light, the journey done...
Under the rising, warming sun...
